rulesets.ground: Seamless TOP-DOWN square ground texture for an isometric strategy game, to be skewed into 2:1 diamond tiles. FLAT overhead view — no perspective, no horizon, no objects casting long shadows, no buildings, no characters. The four edges must tile seamlessly against copies of themselves. Detail spread evenly across the whole square, no single focal point, no vignette, no border. Narrow value range and low saturation so that buildings placed on top read clearly (the ground must stay quiet). Hand-painted ink-and-wash, soft painterly shading, muted desaturated palette. NOT pixel art, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D render.
